Whisper - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Whisper is OpenAI's open-source general-purpose speech recognition model for transcription, translation, and language identification. It is a multitask Transformer sequence-to-sequence system trained on large-scale diverse audio, with multilingual support and model sizes ranging from tiny to large plus a faster turbo variant.
